parsed.why: No criminalisation, no documented trans-specific targeting or facilities/border exposure. But hate-crime impunity recurred (lenient fines, closed probes) with only belated prosecution reopenings; conservative clergy, weak anti-discrimination coverage; thin record overall.

Marriage equality, GI anti-discrimination across services, self-ID, hate-speech law, arrests after mob attack. Offsets: 2013 police mistreatment of trans sex workers unresolved, high survey avoidance, custody default by birth sex with only on-request transfer.

Criminalisation with documented enforcement against trans people: 8- and 14-year sentences in men's prisons, arbitrary police arrest and assault, forced stripping and medical exams, extortion, mob violence, moratorium voided. State-directed targeting plus custody exposure.

No criminalisation and paper protections, but documented pattern of unsanctioned attacks (centre attacked 20+ times), alleged police torture unpunished, pride bans, custody searches by birth sex. Societal hostility without working remedy.

Operating protections: facilities access matching gender, hate-crime aggravation, anti-discrimination, high public support, active watchdog. Deducted for first-reading rollback bills targeting self-ID and a historically unpunished trans killing; rollback still pending.
